summary: The registrant, CNL Strategic Capital, LLC, filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose routine monthly net asset value determinations, a public offering price adjustment, and a distribution declaration. The board set NAV per share and new offering prices effective May 29, 2026, and declared cash distributions for June 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is present; this is an ordinary periodic disclosure.
